**Concept used:**

Values of angles of Cosine:

cos 0o = 1

questions.question: A person travels in a car at 40 km/h for 3 hours, on a bike at 30 km/h for 2 hours, and in a train at 80 km/h for 5 hours. What is the average speed at which he travelled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed by car for 3 hours = 40 km/h

speed by bike for 2 hours = 30 km/h

speed by train for 5 hours = 80 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = distance/time taken

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

distance traveled by car = 3 x 40 = 120 km

distance traveled by bike = 2 x 30 = 60 km

distance traveled by train = 5 x 80 = 400 km

Total time taken = 10 hours

Total distance = 580 km

Average speed = (580)/(10)

= 58 km/h

Hence, the correct answer is **'58 km/h'.**

questions.question: 20 men can finish a work in 220 days, but at the end of 90 days, 20 additional men are employed. In how many more days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20 men can finish a work in 220 days.

At the end of 90 days, 20 additional men are employed.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Number of men X Total number of days

**Calculation:**

Let, X more days to complete the work after 90 days.

Total work = Number of men X the total number of days.

Total work = 20 x 220

Total work = 4400.

Work completed after 90 days = 20 x 90 

= 1800

Required work = 1800.

Remaining work = Total work - Work completed after 90 days.

= 4400 - 1800

= 2600.

Remaining work = Total men after new recruitment x X

2600 = 40 x X

X = (2600)/(40)

X = 65.

Thus, **Work will be completed after 65 more days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

20 men can finish a work in 220 days but the first 90 days done remaining days (220 - 90) = 130, then 20 more joined

⇒ 130 × 20 = k × 40 

⇒ k = (130 × 20)/40 = 65 days

Thus, Work will be completed after 65 more days

questions.question: The LCM of 144, 360 and 450 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers = 144, 360, 450.

**Concept used:**

LCM - least common multiple is defined as the smallest multiple that two or more multiples have in common.

**Calculation:**

prime factorization of 144 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3

prime factorization of 360 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 5

prime factorization of 450 = 2 x 3 x 3 x 5 x 5

LCM = 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 5 x 5

= 3600

hence, the correct answer is **'3600'.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers a cash discount of Rs. 85 first and then two successive discounts of 10% and 2% on the marked price of a fan. If the marked price of the fan is Rs. 1,285, what is its selling price (in Rs )?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1st cash discount = Rs. 85

2nd Discount = 10%

3rd Discount = 2%

The marked price of fan = Rs. 1,285

**Formula used:**

The marked price of the item = cost price - discount price 

selling price of item = New marked price after discount.

**Calculations:**

Price of the Fan after 1st discount = Rs. 1285 - Rs. 85 

⇒ Rs. 1200

The new marked price of the fan is = Rs. 1200.

Price of the Fan after 2nd discount = 1200 - 10% of 1200

⇒ 1200 - 120

⇒ Rs. 1080.

The new marked price of the fan is = Rs. 1080

Price of the Fan after 3rd discount = 1080 - 2% of 1080

⇒ 1080 - 21.6

⇒ Rs. 1058.4

∴ **The selling price of the fan is Rs. 1,058.4.**

questions.question: Menu and Daya travel from point A to B, a distance of 105 km, at speeds of 10 km/h and 25 km/h, respectively. Daya reaches point B first and returns immediately and meets Menu at point C. Find the distance from point A to point C.

Menu travels from point A to B, a distance of 105 km, at speeds of 10 km/h.

⇒ t = {105over25} = {21over5}

Menu reach at point O in same time t and travel distance AO. then,

⇒ AO = 10times{21over5}=42 km

Remaining distance OB = 105 - 42 = 63 km 

Now, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f398026c38e69134861e286b48c32069e505959fa2228363ca9b2a5b3f34c01.png] 

Daya and Menu meet at point C and they take the same time. then,

⇒ TimeMₑₙᵤ = TimeDₐyₐ 

⇒ {dover10}={63 - dover25}

⇒ {dover2}={63 - dover5}

⇒ 5d = 126 - 2d

⇒ 7d = 126 

⇒ d = 18 km

So, the distance from point A to point C,

⇒ AC = AO + OC

⇒ AC = 42 + 18 = 60 km.

**∴ The distance from point A to point C is 60 km.**

So, distance from AC = (105 - 45) = 60 km

questions.question: If 36 : 81 :: X : 63, what is the value of X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

36 : 81 :: X : 63

**Concept used:**

Proportionality - Any relation that is always in the same ratio.

**Calculation:**

36 : 81 :: X : 63

(36)/(81) = (X)/(63)

X = 63 × ((36)/(81))

X = (2268)/(81)

X = 28

**Hence, the value of X is 28.**

questions.question: In an election contested between two candidates, 15% of the total voters did not cast their votes and 100 votes got disqualified. The candidate who won the election won by securing 45% of the total votes and won by a margin of 400 votes. Find the total number of voters.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

% voters who did not cast votes = 15%

Number of disqualified votes = 100

Winner candidate won by % of total votes = 45%

Winner candidate won by margin = 400 votes

**Formula used:**

Total votes cast = Winner's votes + loser's votes - vote margin

Total votes cast = Total votes % - % votes who did not cast vote - disqualified votes.

**Calculation:**

​Let total voters be 100%x

Total votes cast = Total votes % - % votes who did not cast vote.

⇒ 100%x - 15%

⇒ 85%x

Votes got disqualified = 100

thus, Total votes cast = 85%x - 100

Winner got 45% of the total votes cast:

loser got = 45%x - 400

According to the question,

85% - 100 = 45%x + 45%x - 400

⇒ 300 = 90%x - 85%x

⇒ 300 = 5%x

⇒ x = 6000

**∴ The total number of voters is 6000.**

questions.question: Two angles of a triangle are equal and the third angle measures 78°. What is the measure of each of the unknown angles?

questions.question: What is the present value of Rs.10,000 received in 2 years, if the interest rate is 12% per year, compounded semi-annually?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate per period = 12% ÷ 2 = 6% = 0.06

Total compounding periods (n) = 2 years × 2 = 4 periods

Present Value (PV) = FV ÷ (1 + r)ⁿ = 10,000 ÷ (1.06)⁴

Using (1.06)⁴ ≈ 1.262477

PV = 10,000 ÷ 1.262477 ≈ ₹7,920.94

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,920.94.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Future Value (FV) = ₹10,000

Annual Interest Rate (R) = 12%

Time (T) = 2 years

Compounding = Semi-annually (m = 2)

**Formula Used:**

Present Value (PV) = FV ÷ [1 + (R ÷ m)]m × T

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 PV = ?
 FV = ₹10,000
 Start (T=0)
 End (T=2 yrs)
 

 

 

 

 4 periods of 6% each
 PV = 10,000 ÷ (1.06)⁴

**Calculations:**

⇒ Semi-annual rate (r) = 12% ÷ 2 = 6% = 0.06

⇒ Number of periods (n) = 2 × 2 = 4

⇒ PV = 10,000 ÷ (1 + 0.06)⁴

⇒ PV = 10,000 ÷ (1.06)⁴

⇒ PV = 10,000 ÷ (1.06 × 1.06 × 1.06 × 1.06)

⇒ PV = 10,000 ÷ 1.26247696

⇒ PV = 7920.9365...

⇒ PV ≈ ₹7,920.94

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,920.94.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Present Value Concept

Present Value (PV) is the current value of a future sum of money or stream of cash flows given a specified rate of return. Formula: PV = FV ÷ (1 + r)ⁿ.

Effect of Compounding Frequency

As the frequency of compounding increases (from annual to semi-annual to monthly), the present value of a fixed future sum decreases because the effective interest rate per year increases.

Compound Interest Formula

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100n)ⁿt, where n is the number of times interest is compounded per year and t is the number of years.

questions.question: A conical vessel (solid) is made of iron. Its base radius is 7 cm and height is 15 cm. If the weight of the iron per cubic centimetre is 15 g, what is the weight of the vessel?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Base radius of conical vessel= 7 cm

Height of conical vessel = 15 cm.

weight of iron per cubic cm = 15 g.

**Concept used:**

Volume of the Conical Vessel =(1)/(3)pi r² h [Where r is the radius of base and h is height of the conic]

**Calculation:**

Volume of the conical vessel is = (1)/(3)×π×(7)²×15=770cm³

Weight of the vessel = 770 × 15 =11550 gm = 11.55 kg.

Hence the correct answer is __**11.55kg**__.
